posts.title: In Memoriam Andrée Ehresmann
posts.description: I recently learned of the death of Andrée Ehresmann through Moreno Andreatta, my collaborator and, more recently, the supervisor of my PhD. The three of us had worked together for many years on the mathematical formalization of Klumpenhouwer networks, and had published a number of papers together.
